An '''ostrine edge''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] [[Edge (weapon)|edge]] that had been augmented by a refined form of a rare, [[Temperature/Legends|heat]]-absorbing [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[ostrine]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]]. Affixed to a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]], the edge emitted an extreme chill that caused additional damage to objects that it struck, and it also partially protected the user from [[Fire/Legends|fires]] and extreme heat by decreasing the surrounding temperature. The edge was silver in [[Color/Legends|color]] except for a red part of the edge near the weapon's [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]]. Used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="kotor2" /> in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the weapon upgrade sold for 28,850 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ostrine edge appeared in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. The melee weapon upgrade was rare to acquire and could be found in random locations, but players with a very high repair skill could construct the item at a workbench. A melee weapon upgraded with the edge gave the user a cold damage bonus and a reduction in damage taken from fire-based attacks. The ostrine edge also gave the weapon an increased chance of scoring a critical hit, which dealt increased damage.<ref name="kotor2" />
